name: CEBAF experimental Hall D
notes: Hall-level site created for the hadron-2 coverage stream. The same hall is drawn as geometry:jlab-hall-d (map:jefferson-lab); the map's site_ids and that geometry record's site_id were not edited by this stream (for the integrator).

summary.plain: Hall D is one of the experimental halls at the end of Jefferson Lab's CEBAF electron accelerator in Newport News, Virginia, where the beam strikes targets and detectors record the scattered particles.
summary.technical: CEBAF experimental Hall D (Jefferson Lab building 203): a dome-roofed experimental hall, partly below grade, receiving the recirculated CEBAF electron beam. Point = centroid of the City of Newport News building footprint (about 50 m precision).
